record.paper: Separation choosability and dense bipartite induced subgraphs

dossier_meta.paper: Separation choosability and dense bipartite induced subgraphs
dossier_meta.statement_text: There exist $d_0$ and $g_0$ such that any graph of girth at least $g_0$ with minimum degree at least $d_0$ contains a bipartite induced subgraph of minimum degree at least $3$.
dossier_meta.context_text: This is a further variation on Conjecture 1.4 using large girth instead of triangle-freeness. The weaker statement with 3 replaced by 2 (i.e., containing an even hole) is true with $g_0 = 4$ and $d_0 = 3$ by Radovanović–Vušković; detecting bipartite induced subgraphs of minimum degree at least 3 is NP-complete.
